infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Kleos records a short clip of you answering a prompt so Poise can read how you come across. Clips are measured, never shared, and deleted after they are read.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Kleos listens during conversations so the other person can reply and Poise can measure pace, fillers and tone.

plugins.cameraPermission: Kleos records a short clip so Poise can read how you come across.
plugins.microphonePermission: Kleos listens during conversations to measure your voice.
